_doc: Field list for cc_evidence/baseline.json (schema_version 1). All fields are required; zhtools/cc_check.py validates presence, schema_version and status.

fields.status: "frozen" | "draft"; only frozen evidence may ever produce a verified result
fields.srcdir: absolute path of the Make VPATH srcdir
fields.builddir: absolute path of the Make builddir
fields.cc: absolute path of the C compiler, e.g. /usr/bin/gcc
fields.cxx: absolute path of the C++ compiler, e.g. /usr/bin/g++
fields.configure_args: list of strings, the complete frozen configure arguments
fields.env: object of environment variables that affect the build (CC, CXX, CFLAGS, LDFLAGS, PKG_CONFIG_PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, ...)

logs.world_bin: sha256 of the make -j1 -w world-bin log
logs.checkprep: sha256 of the make -j1 -w checkprep log

fields.n_variants: int, number of records in commands.jsonl
fields.n_objects: int, number of active .o files found in builddir
fields.coverage_closed: bool, true only when every active object has .o, .Po and argv
fields.token_cache_sha256: sha256 over the sorted token hashes (cache key component)
